system_description.narrative_title: Trump‑Xi Summit as Pivot of US‑China Strategic and Economic Reordering
system_description.narrative_summary: A high‑stakes summit between Presidents Trump and Xi is the organizing event driving diplomatic, economic and security shifts: negotiations on AI governance, tariffs and critical minerals intersect with military moves (Greenland/arctic), corporate stress in autos and tech, and Beijing’s domestic controls. The window shows a mix of tactical cooperation and competitive hedging, with supply‑chain levers (rare earths, EV supply), regulatory actions and military positioning amplifying systemic fragilities and feedbacks.
system_description.scope: The bilateral US–China summit ecosystem: diplomatic channels and preparatory talks (e.g., Bessent–He meetings), AI and technology governance dialogues, trade/tariff negotiations, critical minerals/rare‑earth flows, Arctic/Greenland security arrangements, market and corporate reactions (automakers, chip/AI firms), and immediate regional security flashpoints (Taiwan, Pacific).
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical and economic order (great‑power relations, international trade architecture, global technology governance and security alliances).
adjacent_subsystems: Global tech & AI governance and industry (chips, cloud, AI safety frameworks)
Critical minerals & clean‑tech supply chains (rare earths, batteries, EV supply)
Regional security architectures (Indo‑Pacific, Taiwan, Arctic/NATO cooperation)
International trade & manufacturing (automotive industry, tariffs, EU‑UK trade dynamics)
evidence_headlines: What to expect from upcoming summit between Presidents Trump and Xi
US, China set for talks on AI, tariffs and critical minerals ahead of summit
Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
Scott Bessent to meet He Lifeng in New York ahead of Trump-Xi summit
China tightens control of overseas travel in sweeping new law
Chinese rare earth shipments to US drop ahead of Trump-Xi summit

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: The frequency, level and substantive depth of bilateral diplomatic interactions and preparatory talks.

variables.name: Strategic trust level
variables.description: The perceived mutual strategic trust or distrust between the two sides across security and economic domains.

variables.name: Economic interdependence
variables.description: The degree of trade, investment and cross-border economic integration linking the two economies.

variables.name: Trade restriction level
variables.description: The aggregate intensity of tariffs, quotas and non‑tariff measures constraining bilateral trade.

variables.name: Technology governance dialogue intensity
variables.description: The activity level and continuity of negotiations, working groups and dialogues on AI and other tech governance issues.

variables.name: Export control stringency
variables.description: The restrictiveness of export controls and licensing regimes affecting dual‑use technologies and critical inputs.

variables.name: Critical minerals supply concentration
variables.description: The geographic and supplier concentration of critical minerals and rare earth supply chains.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience
variables.description: The robustness and adaptive capacity of cross‑border supply chains for key sectors (autos, semiconductors, batteries).

variables.name: Military posture level
variables.description: The scale and readiness of military presence, deployments and power‑projection activities in contested regions.

variables.name: Alliance and partner cohesion
variables.description: The degree of policy alignment and coordinated action among third‑party allies and partners relevant to the bilateral relationship.

variables.name: Corporate financial stress
variables.description: The level of financial strain across corporate sectors exposed to the bilateral relationship, including profits, writedowns and restructuring pressure.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: The amplitude and frequency of price swings in equity, bond and currency markets tied to geopolitical and summit developments.

variables.name: Cross‑border regulatory intervention rate
variables.description: The rate at which new regulatory actions, investigations or enforcement measures affecting cross‑border commerce are initiated.

variables.name: Skilled labor mobility
variables.description: The ease and volume of cross‑border movement of skilled workers, executives and technical personnel.

variables.name: Public confidence in summit outcomes
variables.description: The level of public and political confidence that summit negotiations will produce stable, predictable outcomes.

variables.name: Cyber and AI security incident frequency
variables.description: The rate of cyberattacks, AI‑related security incidents and public disclosures that affect bilateral technology and security dynamics.

catalysts.title: Trump–Xi summit (Sep 23–25, 2026)
catalysts.description: The scheduled in‑person summit between Presidents Trump and Xi in the US (multi‑day) likely to drive high‑level talks on AI, tariffs, Taiwan and critical minerals.
catalysts.rationale: "Xi to visit the US from September 23-25"; "What to expect"; "US, China set for talks on AI, tariffs and critical minerals".

catalysts.title: Greenland security deal and new bases
catalysts.description: US‑Greenland/Denmark security agreement and planned US military bases in Greenland announced around the summit, altering Arctic military posture and alliance responsibilities.
catalysts.rationale: "EXCLUSIVE: US to open two new military bases in Greenland"; "Trump, Greenland, Denmark to sign deal".

catalysts.title: Drop in Chinese rare‑earth shipments to US
catalysts.description: A near‑term reduction in Chinese rare‑earth shipments to the US, and supplier responses, producing supply pressures and substitution efforts across aerospace and EV supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: "Chinese rare earth shipments to US drop ahead of Trump-Xi summit"; "Rare earths force Trump to be less hostile".

catalysts.title: US–China AI safety meeting in Shenzhen (follow‑up)
catalysts.description: A scheduled follow‑up AI safety meeting in Shenzhen roughly two months after the summit to operationalize AI notification and safety proposals discussed in New York.
catalysts.rationale: "US, China to meet again on AI safety in two months in Shenzhen, Bessent says"; "Bessent proposes U.S.-China AI safety notifications".

catalysts.title: LNG tariff talks at summit
catalysts.description: Negotiations during the summit over cutting tariffs on US LNG that could produce targeted tariff relief and commercial openings if agreed.
catalysts.rationale: "US, China discuss cutting tariffs on US LNG ahead of Xi visit"; "Trump, Xi seek trade stability and deals".

catalysts.title: US lawmakers press to maintain Chinese automaker ban
catalysts.description: Ongoing congressional pressure on the administration to keep bans/limits on Chinese automakers entering US markets, influencing regulatory and trade outcomes.
catalysts.rationale: "US lawmakers urge Trump to maintain ban on Chinese automakers"; "Auto industry urges Trump not to allow Chinese cars".

catalysts.title: China's tightened overseas travel law (ongoing effect)
catalysts.description: New Chinese law restricting overseas travel will constrain movement of personnel, affecting corporate exchanges, talent flows and diplomatic engagement in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: "China tightens control of overseas travel in sweeping new law"; "China tightens control..." (FT/Reuters coverage).

catalysts.title: Chinese Central Committee plenum (Oct 26–29, 2026)
catalysts.description: The scheduled Central Committee plenum where leadership may set economic, security and export control priorities that shape US‑China interactions.
catalysts.rationale: "Xi chairs Politburo; Central Committee plenum set for October 26-29"; plenum likely to set policy priorities.
